note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals and variable assignments. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines model architecture, training schedule, and runtime settings for a FOVEA object detector with ResNet-50 backbone on COCO.
summarize_config: summarize the FOVEA ResNet-50 FPN object detection config for COCO dataset
review_model_architecture: review the FOVEA model architecture with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck settings
review_loss_functions: review the FocalLoss and SmoothL1Loss configuration for the FoveaHead bounding box head
review_test_cfg: review the test configuration including NMS threshold and score threshold settings
review_optimizer: review the SGD optimizer settings with learning rate 0.01 and momentum 0.9
